name: geneaquilt
description: A browser-first GeneaQuilt implementation backed by Rust and WebAssembly.

scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:rust
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:rust
scripts.format:js: prettier --write web scripts package.json package-lock.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:rust
scripts.format:check:js: prettier --check web scripts package.json package-lock.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:cloudflare
